description: Mint items from a live MomoSwap NFT drop, priced off its bonding curve (each mint costs a little more than the last; the trade fee is on top). `count` 1–10, one transaction each, sent in order; if one fails the ones already minted are kept and reported. Each item is capped at `maxCookPerItem` (fee included) — or, without it, the current price plus `slippageBps` (default 100 = 1%) — and the program refuses to charge more. After a drop graduates at its target, a mint is a REQUEST: you pay now and a keeper settles a random remaining item within seconds. A wallet may hold up to 10 requests open per drop, so `count` places that many, one transaction each (an external signer places one per call). The art stays hidden until the sale ends. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)

maxCookPerItem.description: the most one item may cost in COOK, fee included

slippageBps.description: price tolerance when maxCookPerItem is not set (default 100 = 1%)

name: nft_drop_mint
title: Mint from an NFT drop
